While this card is shown, an approximate position (about 10 km) is sent to Open-Meteo every 30 minutes, also when the Weather switch is off.
Log the car\'s buttons and knob

Write each button press and knob turn the car sends into this log: the key code, down or up, and how far the knob turned. No touches and nothing about you are recorded. At most 120 lines per connection.
Map apps follow the car\'s lights
Map apps switch between day and night colours when the car does, even when the colours above are always dark or always light.
